purpose: Close vNext with finite, auditable gates while preserving future improvements as NEXT_VERSION_CANDIDATE.
north_star: Owner-governed, evidence-grounded, recoverable, self-improving autonomous operating system

required_now: North Star logical architecture and provider-neutral adapter boundaries
Deterministic bootstrap and dual physical recovery evidence
not_required_now: All logical institutions as separate agents/services

blocking_acceptance_criteria.criterion: No unresolved MATERIAL_ARCHITECTURE_GAP after Lab Architecture Gap Analysis
Vault clears canonical identity, anti-rollback, provenance, bootstrap and dual-root recovery as no MATERIAL_BLOCK
North Star Architecture defines provider/tool/source adapter boundaries and provider-independent Multiverse identity
Self-Evolution Protocol prevents direct unreviewed production/constitution mutation and defines canary/promotion/monitor/rollback
Permission model and Autonomy L0-L5 explicitly state that higher autonomy does not widen forbidden or Owner-gated permissions
Threat/security/recovery categories have either architecture coverage or an explicit deferred implementation plan with no material uncovered category
Current accepted-state recovery can be reconstructed without chat memory and material bytes exist in at least two physical recovery roots
Keirin firewall remains unchanged: holdout sealed, DEV2000 C not consumed for new-lineage rescue, no protected RESULT/PAYOUT leakage, no validation trial consumption
Exact resume procedure resolves latest legitimate verified Keirin state and cannot be rolled back by stale pause artifacts
Auditor reviews the acceptance candidate and finds no release-blocking issue
Known nonblocking improvements are recorded as NEXT_VERSION_CANDIDATE rather than keeping vNext open
No new spend or provider lock-in is required to satisfy vNext under current Owner constraints

definition_of_done: All blocking acceptance criteria PASS or are explicitly satisfied by equivalent stronger evidence; no unresolved MATERIAL_BLOCK; acceptance receipt pins exact artifacts/commit; rollback/recovery path verified; then core upgrade work pauses and Keirin exact-resumes from the latest legitimate verified canonical state.

reopen_current_version_only_if: new evidence invalidates an acceptance claim

owner_burden_target: Routine routing/research/file/SHA/recovery work remains system responsibility; Owner receives only material gates and consolidated exceptions.
